Le premier panneau léger pour une performance supérieure en ce qui concerne la résistance à l’humidité et aux moisissures dans une variété de constructions intérieures. Description du produit
Panneau de gypse Sheetrock Mold Tough Ultra Léger, 1/2" x 4' x 8' When tested in accordance with ASTM D3273, Standard Test Method for Resistance to Growth of Mold on the Surface of Interior Coatings in an Environmental Chamber, the panels meet or exceed ASTM C1396 specifications. The green face paper is folded around the long edges to reinforce and protect the core and the ends are square and even. The long edges of the panel are tapered, allowing joints to be reinforced and concealed with Sheetrock® or Synko® Brand joint treatment systems. • The industry's first and only lightweight 12.7 mm (1/2 in.) moisture- and mould-resistant gypsum panels • Features a noncombustible, moisture-resistant gypsum core encased in moisture- and mould-resistant green face and brown back papers • Superior score and snap for cleaner edges and faster installation • Comply with ASTM C1396, Standard Specification for Gypsum Board, for 12.7 mm (1/2 in.) water-resistant gypsum wallboard and 1/2 in. (12.7 mm) exterior gypsum soffit board • When tested in accordance with ASTM D3273, the panels meet or exceed ASTM C1396 specifications • Achieved GREENGUARD Gold Certification and qualifies as a low VOC emitting material (meets CA 01350)
